finding.title: Potential OS Command Injection via Filename
finding.trigger: An attacker could provide a filename with shell metacharacters or special sequences to execute arbitrary commands.
finding.assumptions: The filename is derived from untrusted input and the system's shell is used to interpret the filename.

finding.title: Potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via fillColor
finding.trigger: An attacker could inject malicious SVG code or scripts within fillColor.
finding.assumptions: The fillColor is derived from untrusted input and is directly embedded into the SVG output.

finding.title: Potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via strokeColor and fillColor
finding.trigger: An attacker could inject malicious SVG code or scripts within strokeColor or fillColor.
finding.assumptions: The strokeColor and fillColor are derived from untrusted input and are directly embedded into the SVG output.
